loire.d: the longest French river; rises in the Massif Central and flows north and west to the Atlantic Ocean

loin.d: either side of the backbone between the hipbone and the ribs in humans as well as quadrupeds

loincloth.d: a garment that provides covering for the loins

loins.d: the lower part of the abdomen just above the external genital organs

loiterer.d: someone who lingers aimlessly in or about a place
